episodes.title: A Mysterious Florida Cult with Ghost Stories | Koreshan State Park
episodes.description:
Deep in Estero, Florida lies the abandoned settlement of a forgotten cult that believed we live inside the Earth. In this video, we explore the strange history of the Koreshan Unity — founded by Cyrus Teed in the late 1800s — their bizarre hollow earth theology, their rise and decline, and the ghost stories that still surround the site today. Now preserved as Koreshan State Park, this hidden piece of Florida history is one of the strangest you’ve probably never heard of.

If you enjoy hidden history, roadside curiosities, and forgotten places in Southwest Florida, subscribe for more videos like this one.
